definition: Automatic clustering algorithms are algorithms that can perform clustering without prior knowledge of data sets.
details: In contrast with other clustering techniques, automatic clustering algorithms can determine the optimal number of clusters even in the presence of noise and outliers.
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. That care with the raw material is Automatic clustering algorithms.
